# Glenford Rocks

> Glenford Rocks creates bluestone furniture, sculptural installations and functional outdoor art in Glenford, New York.

## Primary information

- Website: https://glenfordrock.com/
- Resources: https://glenfordrock.com/links/
- Location: Glenford, New York, in the Hudson Valley
- Email: glenfordsales@hotmail.com
- Phone: +1-845-679-7555
- Work: Bluestone benches, chairs, tables, firepits, installations, sculptures and Sunsails
- Material: Hudson Valley bluestone
- Furniture construction: Fully stable bluestone slabs with solid steel round or square stock
- Availability: Work, visits, pricing and delivery are discussed directly with Glenford Rocks

## About

Glenford Rocks is both a range of outdoor furnishings and a long-term vision for an earth-sculpture park on a former 12-acre bluestone quarry. The site reflects an interest in Hudson Valley quarry history, art, green design, nature and public open space.

## Furniture details

- Benches use 1.25-inch solid round steel stock. Prices vary by size.
- Chairs use 1-inch solid round steel stock.
- Tables are available at 17-inch or 30-inch height, with larger coffee tables and a triangle model represented.
- Firepits are 30 inches in diameter, have a stainless steel bowl and use 3/4-inch solid square steel stock.
- Present benches and chairs are one of a kind; cut-stone models may also be offered.

## Other work

Glenford Rocks designs bluestone walls and pathways, sculptural settings and fixture systems that suspend polypropylene Sunsails. Sunsails range from 12 to 24 feet and create shaded outdoor settings.

## Resources

The Glenford Rocks resource collection links to third-party sources about Hudson Valley bluestone history, Ulster County quarrying, sculpture parks, landscape art and biophilia. It includes local and official sources from Friends of Historic Kingston, the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation, the National Park Service and regional sculpture institutions, as well as clearly labeled historical archives.

These external resources provide context and inspiration. Glenford Rocks does not claim authorship of or responsibility for their content.

### Bluestone history sources

- Friends of Historic Kingston: Bluestone History - https://www.fohk.org/bluestone-history/
- New York State Department of Environmental Conservation: Bluestone, From Ancient Sea to American Architecture - https://extapps.dec.ny.gov/docs/administration_pdf/0808bluestone.pdf
- Vassar College Hudson Valley Guidebook: Bluestone Quarries (archived) - https://web.archive.org/web/20220203111208/https://pages.vassar.edu/hudsonvalleyguidebook/2013/06/03/bluestone-quarries/
- Robert Donaldson: The History of Bluestone in Ulster County - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oaKzJDsWjTw
- Popular Science Monthly (1894): The Great Bluestone Industry - https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Popular_Science_Monthly/Volume_45/July_1894/The_Great_Bluestone_Industry
- The Manufacturer and Builder (1890): Bluestone Sidewalks - https://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=coo.31924080795275&view=1up&seq=87&size=125
- Scientific American (1890): Bluestone Sidewalks - https://quarriesandbeyond.org/articles_and_books/pdf/bluestone_sidewalks_scientific_american_november_22_1890.pdf
- The New York Times (1994): Preserving the History That Lies Underfoot - https://www.nytimes.com/1994/06/20/nyregion/preserving-the-history-that-lies-underfoot-bluestone-sidewalks-on-comeback-trail.html
- Wikipedia: Bluestone - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bluestone

### Sculpture and landscape sources

- Opus 40 - https://opus40.org/
- Storm King Art Center - https://stormking.org/
- Grounds For Sculpture - https://www.groundsforsculpture.org/
- deCordova Sculpture Park and Museum - https://thetrustees.org/place/decordova/
- Socrates Sculpture Park - https://socratessculpturepark.org/
- Red Rocks Amphitheatre - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red_Rocks_Amphitheatre
- National Park Service: History and Culture of the Upper Delaware - https://www.nps.gov/upde/learn/historyculture/index.htm
- Wikipedia: Biophilia Hypothesis - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Biophilia_hypothesis

## Important clarification

Exact availability, delivery details and project pricing are provided directly by Glenford Rocks. The website does not publish fixed inventory or fixed pricing.
